parameters.tokenizer: Unicode NFKC and casefold; words with internal apostrophes; no stopword removal or stemming
parameters.query: question stem plus all option texts sorted by normalized text; no added displayed letters

control_rule.description: On the exact historical 300 search IDs, choose an independently seeded corpus fact outside the retrieved top three, in the lower half of BM25 scores and with content-word Jaccard <=0.1 to the query; minimize word-length distance to top one and use seeded stable-ID ties. An independent annotation-only audit must find no supporting-fact matches; annotations do not rank or choose the control.
